documentedChange.scope: Official 1Click confidential-settlement announcement; not proof that every integration migrated at one instant.

signingAccounts.interpretation: Relative ranking of descriptive mean shifts only. Serial dependence, shared trends, endogenous migration and 30-day window selection preclude treating this rank as a randomization p-value or causal effect.

reportedAllSourceVolume.interpretation: Relative ranking of descriptive mean shifts only. Serial dependence, shared trends, endogenous migration and 30-day window selection preclude treating this rank as a randomization p-value or causal effect.

observability.conclusion: Public signing-account counts and reported all-source notional cover different populations. Their divergence and documented confidential settlement invalidate interpreting the public count decline as total network demand loss. Neither the announcement nor this short-window date scan identifies a causal migration effect.

paperAudit.usableImplication: Entry costs, costly effort and congestion make more solver addresses an insufficient welfare statistic; optimal entry may be limited. This is a conditional model prediction, not a NEAR empirical estimate.
paperAudit.neededValidation: Actual independent solver entities, submitted and winning quotes, order size, route, fills, latency, and user execution benchmarks.

replicationPackage.status: Public repository and tag exist; README names committed data, code and result targets. Execution and numerical replication were not performed.

Reports that the 2bps fee went live on Wednesday, consistent with 26 November.

governanceDateDiscrepancy.finding: Fee rollout and reward-cap implementation must be dated separately before accepting a bundled 8 December treatment. Reward-cap activation date not independently established here.

paperAudit.modelCheck: Under the written common reward/fee conditional payoff, argmax(common term minus cost) equals argmin(cost). A change in winner concentration requires additional endogenous entry, cost, inventory, bid or order-selection mechanisms; the common payoff shift alone does not prove Proposition2. Finite-grid invariant self-check executes.
paperAudit.usableMethods: Count-versus-value measures, leave-one-entity-out, order-size segmentation, time/placebo and cross-venue sensitivity. These require correctly observed solver/order identities and a validated event date.
paperAudit.nonTransferable: The CoW treatment coefficients, venue counterfactual, size-bucket estimates and execution-quality bounds do not estimate a NEAR flywheel.
